name: GEF Small Grants Programme Malaysia
summary: Malaysia's SGP country programme funds community-led projects on conservation of threatened ecosystems and species and on sustainable agriculture and fisheries, mostly in priority landscapes and seascapes in Pahang, Johor, Sabah and Sarawak.

status.quote: Deadline : Sunday, 7 June 2026, 11.59 PM Malaysian Time

administered_by.quote: The Global Environment Facility Small Grants Programme (SGP), implemented by UNDP, supports community-led initiatives that address global environmental challenges while improving local livelihoods.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible entities include national: Community-Based Organisations (CBOs) Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs) Civil Society Organisations (CSO), including academic/training institutions Social Enterprises Indigenous Peoples' organisations

geography.quote: In Malaysia, the programme has supported 294 community-based projects over the past 26 years

access.quote: This Call for Proposals invites local organisations and communities to lead solutions grounded in local realities and knowledge.

window.quote: Deadline : Sunday, 7 June 2026, 11.59 PM Malaysian Time
